description: NHK Creative Library (CC-BY 2.1 JP) per-clip license tracker. clipId.description: NHK Creative Library clip ID; format = 'nhk-creative:{clip-numeric-id}'

ccBy21JpVersion.description: Pinned to CC-BY 2.1 JP (specific license version NHK uses)

attributionTextEmittedAttested.description: STRUCTURAL: const true; every downstream artifact derived from this clip MUST emit the attributionText

fleetInternalCarveOutAttested.description: G13 STRUCTURAL: const true; this clip is admitted under fleet-internal carve-out per ADR-2605262100 R1.4 precedent

downstreamArtifactNotExternallyPublished.description: G13 STRUCTURAL: const true; baien artifacts trained on this clip MUST NOT be externally published; LiteLLM + SBT-gate access only

nhkClipUrl.description: Source URL on NHK Creative Library (for attestation provenance; not for active fetch)

snapshotCid.description: IPFS CID of pinned snapshot of this clip

sourceMetadataCid.description: IPFS CID of NHK-provided metadata document
